description.value:
Activation: 8

Patience is its own kind of violence.

At the start of each of your turns, if the creature bearing your Insight is in Attunement Range, place 1 Insight on it (up to the cap). When that creature takes damage from any source, you recover 1 Investiture once per round.

description.value:
Activation: 3

Cost: 3 Investiture

The hunt ends here. The knowledge remains.

Spend 3 Investiture and test Red vs. Physical against the creature bearing your Insight. On success, deal [Tier][Die] Vital damage per Insight and remove all Insight; each ally in Attunement Range may immediately make a free Strike against any enemy within their reach. On failure, deal [Tier][Die] Vital damage and remove 1 Insight. Once per scene.

description.value:
Activation: 8

The kill feeds the pack.

When the creature bearing your Insight drops to 0 HP, you may choose any creature in Attunement Range as a Free Action and place Insight equal to the slain creature's Insight count on it. Each ally in Attunement Range deals [Tier][Die] Vital damage to any enemy of their choice.

description.value:
Activation: 8

The hunt doesn't end. It continues.

When you hit the creature bearing your Insight, deal additional Vital damage equal to your Tier. When that creature drops to 0 HP, you may choose a new creature in Attunement Range as a Free Action and place Insight equal to half the slain creature's Insight count (rounded down) on it.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

The pack sees what you see.

Spend 1 Investiture. For the scene, allies in Attunement Range learn the current HP, conditions, and defenses of the creature bearing your Insight, and deal bonus Vital damage equal to your Tier on attacks against it. Once per round, the first ally to hit that creature places 1 Insight on it.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

It doesn't know it's already been chosen.

Spend 1 Investiture and choose a creature in Attunement Range. Place 2 Insight on it and learn its current HP, conditions, and Physical and Spiritual defenses. You may have Insight on only one creature at a time; placing Insight on a new creature removes all existing Insight. Insight may not exceed 5 and fades at the end of the scene.
